event_summary: Colored light bursts appear and fade over a nighttime waterfront, with matching colored reflections on the rippled water.
raw_event_description: The view shows a dark harbor with buildings and lights along the far shore. Small colored light clusters are already visible in the sky near the center-right. Over time, additional vertical light streaks rise from the shoreline area, circular clusters of red, white, green, and pink points appear, expand into rings or dense round patterns, then dim. The water below shows elongated colored reflections that brighten and change color as the sky lights change. Near the end, several adjacent red and pink circular light patterns are visible at once above the shoreline.

reasons: Small colored sky light clusters are already visible in the first frame.
The scene is distant and dark, with the shoreline and water visible but many details obscured.
The source area of the vertical light streaks is not clearly resolved.
